Iola Leroy

Or, shadows uplifted

Frances Ellen Watkins Harper

A young woman raised as white is sold into slavery and after the Civil War gives her life to her people: one of the first novels by an African-American woman.

docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
A young woman raised as white is sold into slavery and after the Civil War gives her life to her people: one of the first novels by an African-American woman.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Frances Ellen Watkins Harper (1825–1911), Iola Leroy, or Shadows Uplifted, 1892, with an introduction by William Still (1821–1902). This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
